complaint.eventDescription: One owner complaint: ODI number, components, crash, fire, injury and death counts, a derived severity, the date the failure happened and the date it was reported with the lag between them, the owner narrative, and whether any recall covers that component. First 3 rows per run are free.

component_trend.eventDescription: One component rolled up across a model year: complaint count, crash, fire, injury and death totals, first and latest incident dates, and whether a recall covers it. Flags parts owners keep reporting with no recall against them. First 3 rows per run are free.
